title: I love the machine
text: I love the machine. It is a great little machine, quiet, works well to humidify a room, but that being said, I am waiting on a replacement as it failed before a month was up. I am going to try again because I liked it soooo much. However, if it fails again, I will move on.

product_metadata.title: Black & Decker Table Top Ultrasonic Humidifier, BXHU090
features: 1.If the power is switched on, the power indicator light will goes out after 3 seconds, which indicates that the equipment can be used normally.
2.There are two working modes: normal spray mode and intermittent spray mode.
3.Self-protection function: the device will automatically shut down after 6 hours of continuous spraying; the device will automatically shut down after 12 hours of intermittent spray mode.
4.Please add water and press the power button if you need it to work again.

Portable, simple, suitable for a variety of environments. Unlimited capacity， water-tight，Non-woven cotton swab, more powerful spray，Super quiet, silent humidification，The combination of function and beauty
